question: Among users who own at least one well-finished post and also own at least one post that received a bounty of 50 in 2011, what percentage of all their posts have a score above 50?

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.XCL_031 > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM posts p
WHERE p.XCL_033 IN (
    SELECT p2.XCL_033
    FROM posts p2
    WHERE p2.XCL_044 IS NOT NULL
)
AND p.XCL_033 IN (
    SELECT p3.XCL_033
    FROM posts p3
    INNER JOIN votes v ON p3.XCL_026 = v.XCL_067
    WHERE v.XCL_071 = 50
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', v.XCL_069) = '2011'
);
